Fixed issue with "Clover" item being highly ineffective (Thanks, DJ!)

CHANGELOG:

 Fixed issue with sounds playing in new scenes from previous scenes
 Increased hit invincibility frames by a very small amount
 Fixed issue that caused the tutorial videos to freeze rarely
 Changed wording on "Idol Reborn" achievement to match how you actually obtain it
 Fixed issue with player having MORE than 3 health causing the elevator UI to break


Thank you to everyone for your patience and support!
